title: Purpose & Calling
intro: Ask a seven-year-old what they will be and you get a job title. This month we widen it — that God has good work for them starting today, that being useful is not the same as being impressive, and that who they are becoming matters more than what they will eventually do.

keyScriptures.text: For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.
For I know the plans I have for you, plans to prosper you and not to harm you.

weeks.title: Made for Something
weeks.declaration: You were made on purpose, for a purpose. God has good work with your name on it, and some of it is for today rather than for when you are grown.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, show our child that their life has a point, and that it has already started. Amen.

weeks.title: Your Purpose Starts Now
weeks.declaration: You do not have to wait until you are older to be useful. The kindness you do this week is real work, and it counts.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, let our child see the good they are already doing. Do not let them wait for permission to matter. Amen.

weeks.title: What You Are Good At
weeks.declaration: The things you enjoy and the things you are good at are not accidents. They were given to you, and they are clues.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, help us notice what You have put in our child, and to say it out loud often enough that they believe it. Amen.

weeks.title: Faithful in Small Things
weeks.declaration: Big things are made of small things done well. Whoever can be trusted with a little is trusted with more.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, teach our child to do ordinary things properly. Build something lasting out of their small faithfulness. Amen.

days.title: Made for Good Work
days.declaration: You were made for good work. God prepared things for you to do before you could hold a pencil.

scripture.text: We are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works.

days.title: Plans for You
days.declaration: God has plans for you, and they are good ones. You are not walking into an empty future.

scripture.text: I know the plans I have for you, plans to prosper you and not to harm you.

days.title: Starting Today
days.declaration: Your purpose does not start when you are grown up. It started the day you were born and it includes today.

scripture.text: Set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith.

days.title: Clues in What You Love
days.declaration: The things you love doing were put in you. Pay attention to them; they are clues, not distractions.

scripture.text: Take delight in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

days.title: You Are Needed
days.declaration: There is something only you are placed to do, in your class, in this family, this week.

scripture.text: God has placed the parts in the body just as he wanted them.

days.title: Small Things Done Well
days.declaration: Do the small thing properly. That is how people end up trusted with the big ones.

scripture.text: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much.

days.title: Not a Job Title
days.declaration: Your purpose is bigger than a job. It is about who you are while you do whatever you do.

scripture.text: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart.

days.title: Helping Is Real Work
days.declaration: Helping someone is not a small thing you do until real life starts. It is real life.

scripture.text: Serve one another humbly in love.

days.title: God Uses Young People
days.declaration: God has never waited for people to grow up before using them. Samuel was a boy; David was the youngest.

scripture.text: Speak, for your servant is listening.

days.title: Practise Now
days.declaration: What you practise now is what you will be able to do later. Nothing you are learning is wasted.

scripture.text: Start children off on the way they should go.

days.title: Being Good at Something
days.declaration: Being good at something is not showing off. It is a gift being used the way it was meant to be.

scripture.text: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, understanding and knowledge.

days.title: What You Do Not Enjoy
days.declaration: Some of your purpose will be things you do not enjoy at first. Do them well anyway; they are part of it.

scripture.text: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with all your might.

days.title: You Are Not a Spare Part
days.declaration: There are no spare parts in God's family. You were included on purpose, not to make up the numbers.

scripture.text: Those parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable.

days.title: Ask What Is Needed
days.declaration: A good question to ask any room is: what is needed here? Purpose often starts with noticing.

scripture.text: Look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.

days.title: Following, Not Guessing
days.declaration: You do not have to guess your way forward. You can follow, one step at a time, and the light is enough.

scripture.text: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

days.title: It Is Fine Not to Know Yet
days.declaration: You do not have to know what you will be. Knowing whose you are is the part that matters now.

scripture.text: In all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.

days.title: Made Different on Purpose
days.declaration: You were not made to do what everyone else is doing. Different was the plan, not the problem.

scripture.text: We have different gifts, according to the grace given to each of us.

days.title: Doing It for God
days.declaration: You can do ordinary things for God — homework, tidying, being kind to your brother. He notices all of it.

scripture.text: Work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord.

days.title: When You Fail at Something
days.declaration: Being bad at one thing tells you nothing about your purpose except which door is not it.

scripture.text: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

days.title: Your Story Is Being Written
days.declaration: Your life is a story that is still being written, and the author is good. The middle is not the ending.

scripture.text: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

days.title: Being Trustworthy
days.declaration: The most useful thing you can be is someone people can rely on. That opens more doors than talent.

scripture.text: Many claim to have unfailing love, but a faithful person who can find?

days.title: Purpose in the Ordinary
days.declaration: Most of your purpose will happen on ordinary days, in ordinary places, with people you already know.

scripture.text: Make it your ambition to lead a quiet life.

days.title: Someone Needs What You Have
days.declaration: Someone this week needs exactly what you are good at. Keep your eyes open for them.

scripture.text: Each of you should use whatever gift you have received to serve others.

days.title: Not a Competition
days.declaration: Your purpose is not a race against anyone else. Nobody can take yours and you cannot take theirs.

scripture.text: Each one should test their own actions.

days.title: Keep Learning
days.declaration: Learning is part of your purpose, not a delay before it. Every skill you gain is a tool you will use.

scripture.text: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge.

days.title: Willing Beats Talented
days.declaration: God has always been more interested in willing people than in talented ones. Willing is something you can choose.

scripture.text: Here am I. Send me!

days.title: Be Where You Are
days.declaration: You cannot do the next thing until you have done this thing. Be properly where you are.

scripture.text: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity.

days.title: You Were Put Here Now
days.declaration: You were born in this time, in this place, on purpose. It is not an accident of timing.

scripture.text: Who knows but that you have come to your position for such a time as this?

days.title: Purpose Is Not Pressure
days.declaration: Having a purpose is not a weight to carry. It is a gift to unwrap slowly, and there is no deadline.

scripture.text: My yoke is easy and my burden is light.

days.title: God Finishes What He Starts
days.declaration: God does not begin things and abandon them. What He started in you, He intends to finish.

scripture.text: The Lord will vindicate me; your love, Lord, endures forever.

days.title: Purpose Goes With You
days.declaration: What you have learned about purpose this month is for using, starting with the very next thing you do.

scripture.text: Created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.
